fixed: P1-1 assignment rules are read fail-closed: missing, empty or malformed deadline, allowed_extensions, max_bytes, allow_multiple_files and requires_official_confirmation produce rules_state=PARTIAL with missing_rules and block prepare/preflight (SUBMISSION_RULE_UNVERIFIED); late_submission_deadline is honoured and only deadline_state=NONE declares no deadline

P1-2 the platform is re-read after the uploads/draft and before the submit request is consumed; a changed window, incomplete rules, changed replaced version, changed assignment digest or a second local plan stops the sequence with no submit request
P1-3 submission_record enforces the submission-v1 allOf rules (only SUBMITTED may be final); a contradictory observation is downgraded with IS_FINAL_CONTRADICTED instead of emitting an invalid record
P1-4 an observation must identify the assignment (assignment_id or assignment_uid); without it no submission-v1 record is built, and verification compares the observed uid independently
P2-1 a replacement is verified only when the observed version is newer than the replaced version; older or equal is VERSION_NOT_VERIFIED
P2-2 cancel, result and execute share the same account binding; another account gets ACTION_ACCOUNT_MISMATCH and cancel reports cancel_reason=LOCAL_CANCEL_NO_REMOTE_EFFECT

P2-3 the synthetic flag and source_evidence_id come from the transport/observation, not a constant; a live (non-synthetic) record is refused with SUBMISSION_LIVE_EVIDENCE_UNVERIFIED and a payload that contradicts the transport gets SYNTHETIC_FLAG_MISMATCH
P2-4 upload and draft receipts must return accepted=true (and a receipt id for uploads/drafts); otherwise the file is REJECTED, later steps are not sent and the code is SUBMISSION_PLATFORM_REJECTED
P2-5 the submission journal read-modify-write takes a per-plan file lock, so concurrent execute/result merges cannot lose an update
P2-6 a failed prepare deletes the file set it just wrote, leaving no orphan record with local paths
P2-7 prune requires the live reference set and never deletes a file set a non-terminal plan still needs
P2-8 prepare warnings are stored separately and merged with each observation instead of being replaced
P2-9 preflight writes its specific codes into the module journal; last_error keeps the specific code and engine_reason keeps the engine's generic reason
P2-10 malformed observation file rows are filtered and reported as OBSERVED_FILE_ROW_INVALID instead of raising AttributeError

acceptance.case: a file edited after preview invalidates the plan even with the same name

acceptance.case: a failure on the second upload keeps the first effect and the recovery state
acceptance.note: File 0 stays ACCEPTED with its receipt, file 1 is UNKNOWN, file 2 is PENDING, and later reads never upload again.

acceptance.case: a lost upload response is never replayed
acceptance.note: The remote keeps the stored staging upload; three result() polls leave the upload count unchanged.

acceptance.case: a saved draft is never reported as a submitted assignment
acceptance.note: DRAFT_SAVED and SUBMITTED-without-observation stay UNKNOWN; a SUBMITTED record requires is_final, result_observed and a remote id.

acceptance.case: an existing submission is not overwritten without replacement authorization
acceptance.note: REPLACE_EXISTING requires the exact version frozen at preview; a version change between preview and execute fails closed, and a later prepare sees the new submission.

acceptance.case: a platform that returns only file names never proves hash equality
acceptance.note: identity_verified can be true while content_verified stays false with CONTENT_HASH_NOT_AVAILABLE in the limitations.

acceptance.case: local cancellation and code rollback never withdraw or resubmit
acceptance.note: cancel() reports remote_changes=NONE and cancel_reason=LOCAL_CANCEL_NO_REMOTE_EFFECT, there is no withdraw API, and result() performs no write.

security_summary.authorization: every plan needs a 4.4 host-authorization-v1 grant bound to the plan, account, business digest and adapter version; MCP arguments, page content and model output never create one
security_summary.request_gate: one exact ordered single-use RequestGate over at most ten requests; bodies are fully determined at preflight from client-derived references
security_summary.dispatch_intent: DISPATCHING, the ticket and the per-step SideEffectLedger entries are durable before the transport is called
security_summary.file_binding: only name/size/sha256 enter the business object; local paths stay in the protected module store; files are re-hashed in preflight and again before each upload
security_summary.rules: a rule the reader did not supply is UNVERIFIED and blocks the plan; the module never turns an omitted field into a permissive default
security_summary.pre_submit: the platform is re-read immediately before the submit request; a changed window, rule set, replaced version or a conflicting local plan stops the sequence
security_summary.storage: THU-SUBMISSION-FILES-1 and THU-SUBMISSION-STATE-1 use the same protect/unprotect as ActionStore (2.2 envelope or Windows DPAPI), atomic temp+fsync+replace, POSIX 0600, a per-plan lock for journal merges; a configured key fails closed instead of falling back to the test codec
security_summary.no_production_path: only a transport that declares synthetic=true is accepted; every request URL uses the reserved /synthetic/ prefix so no real endpoint is guessed; the write switch is off unless THU_LEARN_SUBMIT=1
security_summary.public_output: no local path, file content or note text; the observed submission-v1 record keeps its own remote_submission_id and upload_receipt_id so the user can check the official page
security_summary.replay: no automatic replay anywhere; lost responses leave UNKNOWN and only readback reconciliation follows

remaining_limits: No production transport exists: upload, draft-save, final-submit and result-query endpoints, their response shapes and the result query fields are unverified. That is the recorded blocker, not a hidden placeholder.

The synthetic transport and the /synthetic/ request paths are engineering evidence only; they are never live campus success and cannot be enabled by configuration. The transport declaration is authoritative for a record's synthetic flag; a page or payload cannot claim provenance.
A caller that maps a model with invented defaults must not present them as source values; the fail-closed rule gate depends on the reader telling the truth about what it actually read.

The local single-flight check covers a second plan that is prepared before or during the sequence; two plans that both preflight in the same instant can still race, each plan still dispatches at most once.

Pre-submit rechecking happens inside the dispatch that already holds the one-use gate; it can stop the submit, but it cannot re-authorize a new upload sequence. A stopped plan stays UNKNOWN and requires a new plan.

Reconcile and preflight do not write the action journal by design (a write would collide with the engine's captured revision); their codes live in the module journal and are surfaced through last_error/preflight_errors.

A platform rejection after a request was sent leaves the engine in UNKNOWN (the framework never marks FAILED after a send); the module records SUBMISSION_PLATFORM_REJECTED for the caller but does not claim the write did not happen.
File sets are bounded at 200 and pruning requires the live reference set; a caller using FileSetStore directly must pass it or prune refuses.

Withdrawing a draft, deleting a remote attachment and replacing an existing submission version are not implemented; only an explicit REPLACE_EXISTING plan with the exact replaced version is described.
The engine contract is registered with enabled=false (the write switch is module-owned and off by default) so describe_actions('learn') reports ADAPTER_REQUIRED until 6.1 wires the facade switch.

Older clients ignore the new codes; no remote submission, draft or attachment is created or deleted by this module, and existing action journals remain readable.
